label: LPBF Workflow
description: Material and process setup, transient thermal simulation, build screening and measurement comparison for one process vector.

label: Process Parameter Search
description: Gaussian-process search over power, speed, hatch and layer, scored by the screening build verdict times scan rate; a suggestion, not a qualified window.

label: Solidification Map (cooling and grain structure)
description: Screening G/R, cooling rate, dendrite arm spacing (Hunt–Lu, Kirkwood) and morphology tendency from the Python conduction field; not validated.

label: Melt Pool vs Published Measurements
description: Plots measured multi-track, powder-entrained melt-pool width and depth (CMU Ti-6Al-4V, 370 W) against the current workflow result; a comparison, not validation.

label: Keyhole Laser Absorption
description: Phase 26: GPU-accelerated multiple light scattering inside keyhole via NVIDIA Warp BVH.

label: Model vs Published Datasets (LPBF)
description: Screening kernels (Rosenthal, Eagar–Tsai v2, Goldak v3) against published single-track measurements (Hofmann 316L 2026, Totis Ti-6Al-4V 2021); comparison, not validation; Python-generated record

label: Model Error Scorecard (LPBF)
description: Errors on data the model was not fitted to (each source left out in turn) for the screening melt-pool kernels, with laser absorptivity fitted separately from the solver: per kernel, alloy and regime, interval coverage, regime confusion, Guo N01 failure; screening only, not validation; Python-generated record

label: Materials Database
description: Handbook values, reviewed research references and the active specimen composition editor (wt%); source applicability requires review.

label: Phase Diagrams & CALPHAD
description: Multi-component pycalphad equilibrium, MatCalc open TDB databases and Scheil solidification; CALPHAD needs pycalphad and an installed database covering every selected element, else unavailable.

label: Research Hub
description: Research briefs, source comparison, numeric extraction and reviewed registry links.

label: Measured Findings (user-labelled)
description: Registry findings labelled as measured, with method, source and uncertainty gaps; the label is user-declared, not verified.

label: Export Review Package
description: Exports the active specimen, source provenance and linked evidence as a review package; meshes and worker artifacts are excluded.
